service.en: Permit to stay outside the UAE over 6 months
service.ar: تصريح البقاء خارج الدولة لأكثر من 6 أشهر
service.ur: چھ ماہ سے زیادہ ملک سے باہر رہنے کی اجازت
service.ml: ആറ് മാസത്തിലധികം രാജ്യത്തിന് പുറത്ത് തങ്ങാനുള്ള അനുമതി

about: Let a resident keep their residence while staying outside the UAE for more than six months.
note: Requirements read from the official ICP service page on the checked date. ICP fills the form in from the person's records after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Residents only, applying from outside the UAE
More than 30 days must remain on the residence
Apply after 180 days outside the UAE, with a valid reason
Not available to residents of Dubai
Enter within 30 days of approval; Golden, Green and Blue holders are exempt
documents: Proof of the reason for staying abroad
fees: 100 AED issuance for each month of delay after six months
100 AED fine for every 30 days or less outside the UAE
channels: ICP Smart App or ICP Smart Services website (sign in with UAE PASS)
